## Functions

```{r load-spatial-objects}
load_spatial_objects <- function(dataset_info) {
  # Read each Seurat object and keep dataset labels as list names.
  objects <- lapply(dataset_info$file, readRDS)
  names(objects) <- dataset_info$dataset
  objects
}
```

```{r make-custom-liana-resource}
make_custom_liana_resource <- function(custom_pairs) {
  # Add selected literature pairs to LIANA's Consensus resource.
  base_lr <- liana::select_resource("Consensus")[[1]]

  custom_pairs_full <- custom_pairs %>%
    mutate(
      source = source_genesymbol,
      target = target_genesymbol,
      category_intercell_source = "custom_ligand",
      database_intercell_source = "Custom",
      category_intercell_target = "custom_receptor",
      database_intercell_target = "Custom",
      sources = "Custom_added_from_literature",
      references = NA_character_
    )

  missing_cols <- setdiff(names(base_lr), names(custom_pairs_full))
  custom_pairs_full[missing_cols] <- NA
  custom_pairs_full <- custom_pairs_full[, names(base_lr)]

  bind_rows(base_lr, custom_pairs_full) %>%
    distinct(source_genesymbol, target_genesymbol, .keep_all = TRUE)
}
```

```{r check-custom-liana-resource}
check_custom_liana_resource <- function(custom_lr, custom_pairs) {
  # Check whether the custom pairs are present in the resource.
  selected_lr <- paste(
    custom_pairs$source_genesymbol,
    custom_pairs$target_genesymbol,
    sep = " -> "
  )

  custom_lr %>%
    filter(
      paste(source_genesymbol, target_genesymbol, sep = " -> ") %in% selected_lr
    ) %>%
    select(source_genesymbol, target_genesymbol, sources)
}
```

```{r prepare-spatial-object}
prepare_spatial_object <- function(obj, assay = "Xenium", celltype_col = "CellTypeManual.l2") {
  # Set assay, set identities, and normalize the object.
  DefaultAssay(obj) <- assay
  Idents(obj) <- celltype_col

  NormalizeData(
    obj,
    assay = assay,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
}
```

```{r run-liana-dataset}
run_liana_dataset <- function(
    obj,
    dataset_name,
    custom_lr,
    assay = "Xenium",
    celltype_col = "CellTypeManual.l2"
) {
  # Run LIANA and aggregate method ranks for one dataset.
  liana_wrap(
    obj,
    resource = "custom",
    external_resource = custom_lr,
    idents_col = celltype_col,
    assay = assay
  ) %>%
    liana_aggregate() %>%
    mutate(dataset = dataset_name, .before = 1)
}
```

```{r run-liana-all}
run_liana_all <- function(
    objects,
    custom_lr,
    assay = "Xenium",
    celltype_col = "CellTypeManual.l2"
) {
  # Run LIANA for all datasets and return per-dataset and combined results.
  liana_by_dataset <- lapply(
    names(objects),
    function(dataset_name) {
      run_liana_dataset(
        objects[[dataset_name]],
        dataset_name,
        custom_lr = custom_lr,
        assay = assay,
        celltype_col = celltype_col
      )
    }
  )

  names(liana_by_dataset) <- names(objects)

  list(
    by_dataset = liana_by_dataset,
    all = bind_rows(liana_by_dataset)
  )
}
```

```{r make-direction-top-table}
make_direction_top_table <- function(
    liana_all,
    source_type,
    target_type,
    top_n = 20
) {
  # Keep both directions between the same two cell types and show top pairs.
  liana_all %>%
    filter(
      (source == source_type & target == target_type) |
        (source == target_type & target == source_type)
    ) %>%
    arrange(dataset, source, target, aggregate_rank) %>%
    mutate(
      direction = paste(source, target, sep = " -> "),
      lr_complex = paste(ligand.complex, receptor.complex, sep = " -> ")
    ) %>%
    group_by(dataset, direction) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(
      dataset,
      direction,
      lr_complex,
      aggregate_rank,
      mean_rank,
      everything()
    )
}
```

```{r make-direction-comparison-table}
make_direction_comparison_table <- function(
    liana_all,
    dataset_info,
    source_type,
    target_type,
    sig_cutoff = 0.05
) {
  # Compare whether each significant LR pair appears in each dataset.
  sig_pairs <- liana_all %>%
    filter(
      source == source_type,
      target == target_type,
      aggregate_rank <= sig_cutoff
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      lr_complex = paste(ligand.complex, receptor.complex, sep = " -> ")
    ) %>%
    distinct(ligand.complex, receptor.complex, lr_complex)

  full_for_sig_pairs <- liana_all %>%
    filter(
      source == source_type,
      target == target_type
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      dataset_info %>% select(dataset, dataset_short),
      by = "dataset"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      lr_complex = paste(ligand.complex, receptor.complex, sep = " -> ")
    ) %>%
    semi_join(
      sig_pairs,
      by = c("ligand.complex", "receptor.complex", "lr_complex")
    ) %>%
    group_by(dataset_short, ligand.complex, receptor.complex, lr_complex) %>%
    slice_min(aggregate_rank, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      significant = if_else(aggregate_rank <= sig_cutoff, 1L, 0L)
    ) %>%
    select(
      dataset_short,
      ligand.complex,
      receptor.complex,
      lr_complex,
      aggregate_rank,
      mean_rank,
      significant
    )

  comparison_table <- expand_grid(
    sig_pairs,
    dataset_short = dataset_info$dataset_short
  ) %>%
    left_join(
      full_for_sig_pairs,
      by = c("ligand.complex", "receptor.complex", "lr_complex", "dataset_short")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      significant = replace_na(significant, 0L)
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = dataset_short,
      values_from = c(significant, aggregate_rank, mean_rank),
      names_glue = "{dataset_short}_{.value}"
    )

  significant_cols <- grep("_significant$", names(comparison_table), value = TRUE)
  comparison_table$.sort_significant_count <- rowSums(
    comparison_table[significant_cols],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  comparison_table %>%
    arrange(
      desc(.sort_significant_count),
      lr_complex
    ) %>%
    select(
      lr_complex,
      ends_with("_significant"),
      ends_with("_aggregate_rank"),
      ends_with("_mean_rank")
    )
}
```

```{r make-direction-presence-table}
make_direction_presence_table <- function(
    liana_all,
    dataset_info,
    source_type,
    target_type,
    sig_cutoff = 0.05
) {
  # Mark significant LR pairs as present or absent in each dataset.
  liana_all %>%
    filter(
      source == source_type,
      target == target_type,
      aggregate_rank <= sig_cutoff
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      dataset_info %>% select(dataset, dataset_short),
      by = "dataset"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      lr_complex = paste(ligand.complex, receptor.complex, sep = " -> ")
    ) %>%
    distinct(dataset_short, ligand.complex, receptor.complex, lr_complex) %>%
    mutate(significant = 1L) %>%
    complete(
      nesting(ligand.complex, receptor.complex, lr_complex),
      dataset_short = dataset_info$dataset_short,
      fill = list(significant = 0L)
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = dataset_short,
      values_from = significant,
      names_glue = "{dataset_short}_significant"
    )
}
```

```{r calculate-pair-expression-support}
calculate_pair_expression_support <- function(
    obj,
    pair_table,
    source_type,
    target_type,
    assay = "Xenium",
    celltype_col = "CellTypeManual.l2"
) {
  # Calculate expression and detection support for one source-target direction.
  expr_norm <- GetAssayData(
    obj,
    assay = assay,
    layer = "data"
  )

  expr_counts <- GetAssayData(
    obj,
    assay = assay,
    layer = "counts"
  )

  cells <- intersect(colnames(expr_norm), rownames(obj@meta.data))
  expr_norm <- expr_norm[, cells, drop = FALSE]
  expr_counts <- expr_counts[, cells, drop = FALSE]

  cell_type <- obj@meta.data[colnames(expr_norm), celltype_col]
  source_cells <- colnames(expr_norm)[cell_type == source_type]
  target_cells <- colnames(expr_norm)[cell_type == target_type]

  lapply(seq_len(nrow(pair_table)), function(i) {
    ligand <- pair_table$ligand.complex[i]
    receptor <- pair_table$receptor.complex[i]
    lr_complex <- pair_table$lr_complex[i]

    ligand_genes <- unlist(strsplit(ligand, "_"))
    receptor_genes <- unlist(strsplit(receptor, "_"))

    ligand_genes_use <- intersect(ligand_genes, rownames(expr_norm))
    receptor_genes_use <- intersect(receptor_genes, rownames(expr_norm))

    ligand_expr <- if (length(ligand_genes_use) > 0) {
      colMeans(expr_norm[ligand_genes_use, source_cells, drop = FALSE])
    } else {
      rep(0, length(source_cells))
    }

    ligand_detected <- if (length(ligand_genes_use) > 0) {
      colSums(expr_counts[ligand_genes_use, source_cells, drop = FALSE] > 0) ==
        length(ligand_genes_use)
    } else {
      rep(FALSE, length(source_cells))
    }

    receptor_expr <- if (length(receptor_genes_use) > 0) {
      colMeans(expr_norm[receptor_genes_use, target_cells, drop = FALSE])
    } else {
      rep(0, length(target_cells))
    }

    receptor_detected <- if (length(receptor_genes_use) > 0) {
      colSums(expr_counts[receptor_genes_use, target_cells, drop = FALSE] > 0) ==
        length(receptor_genes_use)
    } else {
      rep(FALSE, length(target_cells))
    }

    ligand_mean_expr <- mean(ligand_expr)
    receptor_mean_expr <- mean(receptor_expr)
    ligand_detected_fraction <- mean(ligand_detected)
    receptor_detected_fraction <- mean(receptor_detected)

    data.frame(
      lr_complex = lr_complex,
      ligand.complex = ligand,
      receptor.complex = receptor,
      ligand_expr_source = ligand_mean_expr,
      receptor_expr_target = receptor_mean_expr,
      pair_expr_score = sqrt(ligand_mean_expr * receptor_mean_expr),
      ligand_detected_fraction_source = ligand_detected_fraction,
      receptor_detected_fraction_target = receptor_detected_fraction,
      pair_detected_score = sqrt(
        ligand_detected_fraction * receptor_detected_fraction
      )
    )
  }) %>%
    bind_rows()
}
```

```{r make-expression-table}
make_expression_table <- function(
    objects,
    dataset_info,
    presence_table,
    source_type,
    target_type,
    assay = "Xenium",
    celltype_col = "CellTypeManual.l2"
) {
  # Add expression and detection support to the significant-pair table.
  expression_by_dataset <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(dataset_info)), function(i) {
    dataset_name <- dataset_info$dataset[i]
    dataset_short <- dataset_info$dataset_short[i]

    calculate_pair_expression_support(
      objects[[dataset_name]],
      presence_table,
      source_type = source_type,
      target_type = target_type,
      assay = assay,
      celltype_col = celltype_col
    ) %>%
      mutate(dataset_short = dataset_short, .before = 1)
  }) %>%
    bind_rows()

  expression_wide <- expression_by_dataset %>%
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = c(lr_complex, ligand.complex, receptor.complex),
      names_from = dataset_short,
      values_from = c(
        ligand_expr_source,
        receptor_expr_target,
        pair_expr_score,
        ligand_detected_fraction_source,
        receptor_detected_fraction_target,
        pair_detected_score
      ),
      names_glue = "{dataset_short}_{.value}"
    )

  expression_table <- presence_table %>%
    left_join(
      expression_wide,
      by = c("lr_complex", "ligand.complex", "receptor.complex")
    )

  if (all(c("control_pair_expr_score", "disease_pair_expr_score") %in% names(expression_table))) {
    expression_table <- expression_table %>%
      mutate(
      pair_expr_log2FC_disease_vs_control = log2(
        (disease_pair_expr_score + 1e-6) /
          (control_pair_expr_score + 1e-6)
      )
    )
  }

  significant_cols <- grep("_significant$", names(expression_table), value = TRUE)
  expression_score_cols <- grep("_pair_expr_score$", names(expression_table), value = TRUE)

  expression_table$.sort_significant_count <- rowSums(
    expression_table[significant_cols],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  expression_table$.sort_expression_score <- rowSums(
    expression_table[expression_score_cols],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  expression_table %>%
    arrange(
      desc(.sort_significant_count),
      desc(.sort_expression_score),
      lr_complex
    ) %>%
    select(
      lr_complex,
      ends_with("_significant"),
      ends_with("_ligand_expr_source"),
      ends_with("_receptor_expr_target"),
      ends_with("_pair_expr_score"),
      any_of("pair_expr_log2FC_disease_vs_control"),
      ends_with("_ligand_detected_fraction_source"),
      ends_with("_receptor_detected_fraction_target"),
      ends_with("_pair_detected_score")
    )
}
```

```{r make-selected-liana-dotplots}
make_selected_liana_dotplots <- function(
    liana_all,
    selected_pairs,
    source_type,
    target_type,
    dataset_info
) {
  # Make one LIANA dotplot per dataset for selected LR pairs.
  liana_selected <- liana_all %>%
    mutate(
      lr_complex = paste(ligand.complex, receptor.complex, sep = " -> ")
    ) %>%
    filter(
      source == source_type,
      target == target_type,
      lr_complex %in% selected_pairs
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      lr_complex = factor(lr_complex, levels = selected_pairs)
    )

  plots <- lapply(dataset_info$dataset, function(dataset_name) {
    liana_selected %>%
      filter(dataset == dataset_name) %>%
      arrange(lr_complex) %>%
      liana_dotplot(
        source_groups = source_type,
        target_groups = target_type,
        ntop = length(selected_pairs),
        magnitude = "sca.LRscore",
        specificity = "natmi.edge_specificity",
        colour.label = "Expression level",
        size.label = "Interaction specificity"
      ) +
      ggtitle(paste0(dataset_name, ": ", source_type, " -> ", target_type)) +
      guides(
        size = guide_legend(order = 1),
        colour = guide_colourbar(order = 2)
      )
  })

  names(plots) <- dataset_info$dataset
  plots
}
```

```{r make-expression-bar-data}
make_expression_bar_data <- function(
    expression_table,
    dataset_info,
    selected_pairs = NULL
) {
  # Convert the wide expression table into long format for plotting.
  expression_table_plot <- expression_table

  if (!is.null(selected_pairs)) {
    expression_table_plot <- expression_table_plot %>%
      filter(lr_complex %in% selected_pairs)
  }

  pair_order <- expression_table_plot %>%
    arrange(
      if_else(pair_expr_log2FC_disease_vs_control <= 0, 0L, 1L),
      if_else(
        pair_expr_log2FC_disease_vs_control <= 0,
        pair_expr_log2FC_disease_vs_control,
        -pair_expr_log2FC_disease_vs_control
      ),
      lr_complex
    ) %>%
    pull(lr_complex)

  lapply(seq_len(nrow(dataset_info)), function(i) {
    dataset_name <- dataset_info$dataset[i]
    dataset_short <- dataset_info$dataset_short[i]

    significant_col <- paste0(dataset_short, "_significant")
    expression_col <- paste0(dataset_short, "_pair_expr_score")
    detected_col <- paste0(dataset_short, "_pair_detected_score")

    expression_table_plot %>%
      transmute(
        lr_complex,
        dataset = dataset_name,
        significant = .data[[significant_col]],
        expression_score = .data[[expression_col]],
        detected_score = .data[[detected_col]],
        pair_expr_log2FC_disease_vs_control = pair_expr_log2FC_disease_vs_control
      )
  }) %>%
    bind_rows() %>%
    mutate(
      dataset = factor(dataset, levels = dataset_info$dataset),
      lr_complex = factor(lr_complex, levels = pair_order)
    )
}
```

```{r run-direction-expression-analysis}
run_direction_expression_analysis <- function(
    objects,
    liana_all,
    dataset_info,
    source_type,
    target_type,
    sig_cutoff = 0.05,
    assay = "Xenium",
    celltype_col = "CellTypeManual.l2"
) {
  # Build comparison table, expression table, and bar plot for one direction.
  comparison_table <- make_direction_comparison_table(
    liana_all,
    dataset_info,
    source_type = source_type,
    target_type = target_type,
    sig_cutoff = sig_cutoff
  )

  presence_table <- make_direction_presence_table(
    liana_all,
    dataset_info,
    source_type = source_type,
    target_type = target_type,
    sig_cutoff = sig_cutoff
  )

  expression_table <- make_expression_table(
    objects,
    dataset_info,
    presence_table,
    source_type = source_type,
    target_type = target_type,
    assay = assay,
    celltype_col = celltype_col
  )

  bar_data <- make_expression_bar_data(
    expression_table,
    dataset_info
  )

  list(
    comparison_table = comparison_table,
    expression_table = expression_table,
    bar_data = bar_data,
    bar_plot = plot_expression_bar(
      bar_data,
      source_type = source_type,
      target_type = target_type
    )
  )
}
```

```{r plot-expression-bar}
plot_expression_bar <- function(
    plot_data,
    source_type,
    target_type
) {
  # Plot expression support and label each LR pair with its log2 fold change.
  label_offset <- max(plot_data$expression_score, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.05
  if (!is.finite(label_offset) || label_offset == 0) {
    label_offset <- 0.05
  }

  fc_label_data <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(lr_complex) %>%
    summarise(
      expression_score = max(c(expression_score, 0), na.rm = TRUE) + label_offset,
      pair_expr_log2FC_disease_vs_control = {
        logfc_values <- pair_expr_log2FC_disease_vs_control[
          !is.na(pair_expr_log2FC_disease_vs_control)
        ]
        if (length(logfc_values) == 0) NA_real_ else logfc_values[1]
      },
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      fc_label = ifelse(
        is.na(pair_expr_log2FC_disease_vs_control),
        NA_character_,
        sprintf("%.2f", pair_expr_log2FC_disease_vs_control)
      )
    )

  ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = lr_complex,
      y = expression_score,
      fill = dataset
    )
  ) +
    geom_col(
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
      width = 0.7,
      colour = "black"
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = fc_label_data,
      aes(
        x = lr_complex,
        y = expression_score,
        label = fc_label
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      vjust = -0.2,
      size = 3
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(
        source_type,
        "->",
        target_type,
        "expression support for selected LR pairs"
      ),
      x = "Ligand-receptor pair",
      y = "Pair expression score",
      fill = "Dataset"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.25))
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
    )
}
```

```{r calculate-manual-lr-expression}
calculate_manual_lr_expression <- function(
    obj,
    dataset_name,
    pairs,
    assay = "Xenium",
    celltype_col = "CellTypeManual.l2",
    source_type = "eEVT",
    target_type = "Endothelial"
) {
  # Calculate manual expression, detection, and specificity support.
  expr_counts <- GetAssayData(obj, assay = assay, layer = "counts")
  expr_norm <- GetAssayData(obj, assay = assay, layer = "data")

  meta <- obj@meta.data
  cell_type <- meta[colnames(expr_counts), celltype_col]

  source_cells <- colnames(expr_counts)[cell_type == source_type]
  target_cells <- colnames(expr_counts)[cell_type == target_type]

  all_cell_types <- sort(unique(cell_type))

  get_complex_expr <- function(mat, genes, cells) {
    genes_use <- intersect(genes, rownames(mat))

    if (length(genes_use) == 0) {
      return(rep(NA_real_, length(cells)))
    }

    colMeans(mat[genes_use, cells, drop = FALSE])
  }

  get_complex_detected <- function(count_mat, genes, cells) {
    genes_use <- intersect(genes, rownames(count_mat))

    if (length(genes_use) == 0) {
      return(rep(NA, length(cells)))
    }

    colSums(count_mat[genes_use, cells, drop = FALSE] > 0) == length(genes_use)
  }

  get_mean_by_celltype <- function(mat, genes) {
    genes_use <- intersect(genes, rownames(mat))

    if (length(genes_use) == 0) {
      out <- rep(NA_real_, length(all_cell_types))
      names(out) <- all_cell_types
      return(out)
    }

    expr_vec <- colMeans(mat[genes_use, , drop = FALSE])
    mean_by_type <- tapply(expr_vec, cell_type, mean, na.rm = TRUE)

    out <- rep(0, length(all_cell_types))
    names(out) <- all_cell_types
    out[names(mean_by_type)] <- mean_by_type

    out
  }

  lapply(seq_len(nrow(pairs)), function(i) {
    ligand <- pairs$ligand[i]
    receptor <- pairs$receptor[i]
    lr_complex <- pairs$lr_complex[i]

    ligand_genes <- unlist(strsplit(ligand, "_"))
    receptor_genes <- unlist(strsplit(receptor, "_"))

    ligand_expr_source <- get_complex_expr(expr_norm, ligand_genes, source_cells)
    receptor_expr_target <- get_complex_expr(expr_norm, receptor_genes, target_cells)

    ligand_detected_source <- get_complex_detected(expr_counts, ligand_genes, source_cells)
    receptor_detected_target <- get_complex_detected(expr_counts, receptor_genes, target_cells)

    ligand_mean_source <- mean(ligand_expr_source, na.rm = TRUE)
    receptor_mean_target <- mean(receptor_expr_target, na.rm = TRUE)

    ligand_detected_fraction_source <- mean(ligand_detected_source, na.rm = TRUE)
    receptor_detected_fraction_target <- mean(receptor_detected_target, na.rm = TRUE)

    ligand_by_type <- get_mean_by_celltype(expr_norm, ligand_genes)
    receptor_by_type <- get_mean_by_celltype(expr_norm, receptor_genes)

    ligand_specificity_source <- ligand_by_type[source_type] / sum(ligand_by_type, na.rm = TRUE)
    receptor_specificity_target <- receptor_by_type[target_type] / sum(receptor_by_type, na.rm = TRUE)

    pair_expression_score <- sqrt(ligand_mean_source * receptor_mean_target)
    pair_detected_score <- sqrt(
      ligand_detected_fraction_source * receptor_detected_fraction_target
    )
    pair_specificity_score <- sqrt(
      ligand_specificity_source * receptor_specificity_target
    )

    data.frame(
      dataset = dataset_name,
      lr_complex = lr_complex,
      ligand_expr_source = ligand_mean_source,
      receptor_expr_target = receptor_mean_target,
      pair_expr_score = pair_expression_score,
      ligand_detected_fraction_source = ligand_detected_fraction_source,
      receptor_detected_fraction_target = receptor_detected_fraction_target,
      pair_detected_score = pair_detected_score,
      pair_specificity_score = pair_specificity_score
    )
  }) %>%
    bind_rows()
}
```

```{r make-manual-expression-table}
make_manual_expression_table <- function(
    objects,
    dataset_info,
    selected_lr_manual,
    source_type,
    target_type,
    assay = "Xenium",
    celltype_col = "CellTypeManual.l2"
) {
  # Run manual expression support and return one row per LR pair.
  manual_expression_long <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(dataset_info)), function(i) {
    dataset_name <- dataset_info$dataset[i]
    dataset_short <- dataset_info$dataset_short[i]

    calculate_manual_lr_expression(
      objects[[dataset_name]],
      dataset_name = dataset_name,
      pairs = selected_lr_manual,
      assay = assay,
      celltype_col = celltype_col,
      source_type = source_type,
      target_type = target_type
    ) %>%
      mutate(dataset_short = dataset_short, .before = 1)
  }) %>%
    bind_rows()

  manual_expression_wide <- manual_expression_long %>%
    select(-dataset) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = lr_complex,
      names_from = dataset_short,
      values_from = c(
        ligand_expr_source,
        receptor_expr_target,
        pair_expr_score,
        ligand_detected_fraction_source,
        receptor_detected_fraction_target,
        pair_detected_score,
        pair_specificity_score
      ),
      names_glue = "{dataset_short}_{.value}"
    )

  manual_expression_table <- manual_expression_wide %>%
    left_join(
      selected_lr_manual %>% select(lr_complex, pair_order),
      by = "lr_complex"
    )

  if (all(c("control_pair_expr_score", "disease_pair_expr_score") %in% names(manual_expression_table))) {
    manual_expression_table <- manual_expression_table %>%
      mutate(
        pair_expr_log2FC_disease_vs_control = log2(
          (disease_pair_expr_score + 1e-6) /
            (control_pair_expr_score + 1e-6)
        )
      )
  }

  manual_expression_table %>%
    arrange(pair_order) %>%
    select(
      lr_complex,
      ends_with("_ligand_expr_source"),
      ends_with("_receptor_expr_target"),
      ends_with("_pair_expr_score"),
      any_of("pair_expr_log2FC_disease_vs_control"),
      ends_with("_ligand_detected_fraction_source"),
      ends_with("_receptor_detected_fraction_target"),
      ends_with("_pair_detected_score"),
      ends_with("_pair_specificity_score")
    )
}
```

```{r plot-manual-expression}
plot_manual_expression <- function(
    manual_expression_table,
    dataset_info,
    source_type,
    target_type
) {
  # Plot manual expression support and label each LR pair with its log2 fold change.
  pair_order <- manual_expression_table %>%
    arrange(
      if_else(pair_expr_log2FC_disease_vs_control <= 0, 0L, 1L),
      if_else(
        pair_expr_log2FC_disease_vs_control <= 0,
        pair_expr_log2FC_disease_vs_control,
        -pair_expr_log2FC_disease_vs_control
      ),
      lr_complex
    ) %>%
    pull(lr_complex)

  manual_plot_data <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(dataset_info)), function(i) {
    dataset_name <- dataset_info$dataset[i]
    dataset_short <- dataset_info$dataset_short[i]

    expression_col <- paste0(dataset_short, "_pair_expr_score")

    manual_expression_table %>%
      transmute(
        lr_complex,
        dataset = dataset_name,
        pair_expr_score = .data[[expression_col]],
        pair_expr_log2FC_disease_vs_control = pair_expr_log2FC_disease_vs_control
      )
  }) %>%
    bind_rows() %>%
    mutate(
      dataset = factor(dataset, levels = dataset_info$dataset),
      lr_complex = factor(lr_complex, levels = pair_order)
    )

  label_offset <- max(manual_plot_data$pair_expr_score, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.05
  if (!is.finite(label_offset) || label_offset == 0) {
    label_offset <- 0.05
  }

  fc_label_data <- manual_plot_data %>%
    group_by(lr_complex) %>%
    summarise(
      pair_expr_score = max(c(pair_expr_score, 0), na.rm = TRUE) + label_offset,
      pair_expr_log2FC_disease_vs_control = {
        logfc_values <- pair_expr_log2FC_disease_vs_control[
          !is.na(pair_expr_log2FC_disease_vs_control)
        ]
        if (length(logfc_values) == 0) NA_real_ else logfc_values[1]
      },
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      fc_label = ifelse(
        is.na(pair_expr_log2FC_disease_vs_control),
        NA_character_,
        sprintf("%.2f", pair_expr_log2FC_disease_vs_control)
      )
    )

  ggplot(
    manual_plot_data,
    aes(
      x = lr_complex,
      y = pair_expr_score,
      fill = dataset
    )
  ) +
    geom_col(
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
      width = 0.7,
      colour = "black"
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = fc_label_data,
      aes(
        x = lr_complex,
        y = pair_expr_score,
        label = fc_label
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      vjust = -0.2,
      size = 3
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(
        "Manual expression support for selected",
        source_type,
        "->",
        target_type,
        "LR pairs"
      ),
      x = "Ligand-receptor pair",
      y = "Pair expression score",
      fill = "Dataset"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.25))
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
    )
}
```
